# OverlayModules: Notes

> **File:** `components/content/Notes.qml` · **Schema:** `definitions.NotesOverlayModule` · **Label:** Notes
> **Annotations:** x-link={"setting":"Notes"}, x-icon="sticky_note_2", x-libraryGroup="Tools", x-hosts=["overlay","edgeMenu","desktop"], x-keyboard=true, x-defaultSize=[4,8]

Settings are read as `properties.<key>`.

- **`note`** · string = ""
  - Note: The note to open, as a path in the notes folder (e.g. todo.md or work/ideas.md). Empty opens the last note this module showed.
  - x-scope="machine", x-options="notes"
  - in: `components/content/Notes.qml`
- **`lockNote`** · boolean = false
  - Only this note: Always show this note, with no note list: a clean scratchpad for an edge menu.
  - x-showIf={"note":{"not":""}}
  - in: `components/content/Notes.qml`
- **`showHeader`** · boolean = true
  - Header: The note's name, the note list and the new note button.
  - in: `components/content/Notes.qml`
- **`showToolbar`** · boolean = true
  - Toolbar: The checklist and bullet buttons.
  - in: `components/content/Notes.qml`
- **`showCompleted`** · boolean = true
  - Show completed items: Hidden completed items stay in the note.
  - in: `components/content/Notes.qml`
